theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 ≥ 2 * n + 3 := by
  have h : n ^ 2 - 2 * n - 3 ≥ 0 := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]
    apply Nat.pow_sub_right_distrib
    exact hn
  rw [Nat.sub_le, h]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub]
  exact Nat.zero_le _
